dedupe_keys.name: collaborative research self centering pendulum shear walls in buildings via nonlinear elastic kinematics

description: Collaborative Research: Self-Centering Pendulum Shear Walls in Buildings via Nonlinear Elastic Kinematics is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by Rigoberto Burgueno, Stony Brook University (stonybrook.edu). A new concept for unbonded post-tensioned shear walls was investigated with the objective of obtaining a system that performs damage-free and is self-centering under lateral loads from extreme events. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Keywords: Unbonded Post-Tensioned Shear Walls, Pendulum PC-UPTS Walls, Energy Dissipation, Elastic Instability, Multistable System, Instability. Published 2025-02-03. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
